g.text: Green box: the 3 contractible stuck graphs G14a, G14b, G14c
(I-contractible, not strong I-contractible; word a·a·a⁻¹ on the cycle a).
Below: the 48 stuck graphs with H₁(Δ; ℤ) = ℤ/3, by edge count.
Red: edges in ≠ 2 triangles (identification cycle a).
All 51 are K₄-free, ℤ₂-acyclic, with no I_S-contractible vertex
* cut complex is an annulus; ** cut edges form two 4-cycles.
